title: Quantum Entanglement
summary: Requires High-speed Connection Lv.1 from the Run Tests page, registered by the Java example mod.
description: Requires Logic Arrays Lv.1 and pe_run_tests:java_research_connection Lv.1.
The external prerequisite is shown as a short dashed connection and identified by its page in the tooltip.
This is tier 2 research. Its single reward group can be claimed without a choice step.
